supported_violation.broken_behavior: Terminal-state handling calls failIssueCertificate before comparing CSR with current NextPrivateKey Secret.
supported_violation.causal_explanation: In ProcessItem, Denied/InvalidRequest/Failed branches return failIssueCertificate before PublicKeyMatchesCSR(pk.Public(), csr); a stale request built from a replaced key can therefore fail the current issuance without the required comparison.

plan_postconditions.statement: Before any Denied/InvalidRequest/Ready=Failed terminal-state handling, ProcessItem decodes req.Spec.Request and computes publicKeyMatchesCSR(pk.Public(), csr) against the current NextPrivateKey Secret.
plan_postconditions.planned_check: Inspect pkg/controller/certificates/issuing/issuing_controller.go to confirm the existing CSR decode and PublicKeyMatchesCSR call are relocated before CertificateRequestIsDenied, CertificateRequestHasInvalidRequest, and Ready=Failed handling; build the issuing controller package.
plan_postconditions.check_scope: public-issuing-controller-build only; no runtime request/key fixture or oracle is available.
semantic_statements: The comparison is ordered before terminal-state failure actions.

plan_postconditions.statement: If the CSR does not match the current NextPrivateKey public key, ProcessItem returns nil without calling failIssueCertificate, so a stale request built from a replaced key does not fail the current issuance.
plan_postconditions.planned_check: Inspect the mismatch branch after the relocated comparison to confirm it logs and returns nil before any terminal-state failIssueCertificate call; build the issuing controller package.
plan_postconditions.check_scope: public-issuing-controller-build only; runtime failure suppression is not publicly observable.
semantic_statements: Mismatch defers to requestmanager/keymanager instead of failing issuance.
